records.method: protocol demonstration: OSAM field values scored through the published curves with DEEP's interpolator, banded, compared with the crews' capacity calls
records.outcome: no per-curve support claimed: chance-corrected agreement at or near zero on the four comparable pairs, canopy cover the only pair above chance (weighted kappa +0.23); curves read softer than the crews on substrate and impervious cover (the best-available offset) and harsher on canopy; the riffle pair is not comparable because the fast-water curve is registry-only
not_comparable: not comparable: no shippable scoring curve for this metric in the bundle

dataset_provenance.dataset: Ohio Stream Assessment Method summary data (OSAM)
dataset_provenance.site_selection: every site whose Ecoregion column reads IP (inside ecoregion 71)
dataset_provenance.survey_years: INFORMATION REQUIRED (not recorded in the workbook)
dataset_provenance.capacity_call_derivation: INFORMATION REQUIRED: the workbook maps each measured variable to the function its call belongs to, so the calls may be rubric-derived from the compared indicators

independence.sites: independent of the NRSA development data (no OSAM site is an NRSA site)
independence.variables: different measurement methods per pair (documented in the crosswalk)

design_approval.gate: Phase 6 design gate of the two pilots, applied unchanged to the third region
design_approval.measures: band agreement at the 0.39 and 0.69 breaks with chance expectations, linear-weighted kappa, Spearman correlation with sign, per-site aggregation
design_approval.acceptance_threshold: none claimed at 15 sites; the only decision rule was below-chance agreement or a systematically opposite direction
design_approval.recast: reported as a protocol demonstration with no per-curve support, as for the pilots

summary.offset_direction: mixed: curves softer than the crews on substrate and impervious cover, harsher on canopy cover

history.note: Exploratory field comparison only; not validation
